exposure.needed: whether reports or mutate/generate policies target custom resources the default view role does not cover

consequence.statement: Kyverno controllers can no longer view all resources (including custom resources), which may impact reports and mutate/generate policies on custom resources; admission control policies are not impacted.
consequence.remediation: Grant the controllers view access to the needed custom resources; see the Role Based Access Controls documentation.

assertion.statement: In 1.13 the wildcard view permission of Kyverno controllers was removed and a role binding to the default `view` role was added, so controllers may no longer view custom resources, which may affect reports and mutate/generate policies on custom resources.

checks.detail: no canonical exposure condition for rbac-permission removed
